prompt:
Write a CommonJS JavaScript module. Export exactly the requested function with module.exports = functionName. Use no imports, dependencies, filesystem or network. Return only one fenced javascript code block, with no explanation.

Implement subtractRanges(base, blockers). base and every blocker are half-open numeric ranges [start,end] with start <= end. Return the portions of base not covered by any blocker, as sorted, disjoint, nonempty ranges. Clip blockers to base, ignore empty/outside ranges, and treat overlapping or touching blockers as one union. Preserve both inputs without mutation. Example: base [0,10], blockers [[2,4],[3,6],[8,20]] gives [[0,2],[6,8]].
